subject.title: [Data] Quality signals for ClawHub Skills — we analyzed the top 50 and found trust gaps

question: Should ClawHub expose first-party public skill-quality dimensions, and should any result influence discovery or installability?
rationale: The repository defines internal quality gating and security semantics, but it does not establish who owns public quality judgments, how dimensions are calculated, or whether they may affect marketplace outcomes.

options.title: Informational dimension pilot
options.body: Show separate documented dimensions on skill detail pages without an aggregate grade, ranking effect, moderation effect, or install block.

options.title: Aggregate marketplace score
options.body: Create a first-party overall grade only after defining calibration, anti-gaming, freshness, appeals, and ranking or install behavior.

options.title: External analyzers only
options.body: Keep quality evaluation in third-party tools and avoid a ClawHub-owned quality judgment or marketplace effect.

recommendation.title: Informational dimension pilot
recommendation.body: Show separate documented dimensions on skill detail pages without an aggregate grade, ranking effect, moderation effect, or install block.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest current-main history across the quality, search, security-audit, and moderation-policy boundaries requiring a decision.
